say:1:1830141101:1.text: Oh, all the time! If a Graveborn's been around long enough, they might go through several marriages and divorces!
say:1:1830141101:1.source_cn: 这可太常见了。要是一个亡灵死得太久，还有可能结婚又离婚...
say:1:1830141101:1.male: Oh, all the time! If a Graveborn's been around long enough, they might go through several marriages and divorces!
say:1:1830141101:1.female: Oh, all the time! If a Graveborn's been around long enough, they might go through several marriages and divorces!

say:2:1830141102:1.text: Tell you what, I have this noble client who's been married over two hundred times. He met two-thirds of his wives through me!
say:2:1830141102:1.source_cn: 实话和你说吧，最常光顾我这里的那位贵族，他已经结婚两百...

say:5:1830141105:1.text: Graveborn have no shortage of time, so loneliness is worse than death.
say:5:1830141105:1.source_cn: 亡灵的时间是永恒的，孤独比死亡更可怕。
say:5:1830141105:1.male: Graveborn have no shortage of time, so loneliness is worse than death.
say:5:1830141105:1.female: Graveborn have no shortage of time, so loneliness is worse than death.

say:6:1830141106:1.text: For us, marriage is never the tomb of love, but a refuge from loneliness.
say:6:1830141106:1.source_cn: 婚姻在亡灵眼里不是爱情的坟墓，而是孤独的避难所——反正...
